name: Paladin Defender of the Faith
body:
Most paladins are the sword arm of their faith, marching out to crush the enemies of their world view beneath their mailed boot. The defender of the faith is different, they are the hand holding the shield to stem the tide of their enemies from overtaking their allies.

Mettle (Ex)

At 1st level, a defender of the faith gains a Mettle pool that is refreshed each day. The pool’s maximum is equal to the defender of the faith’s Charisma modifier, plus any feats and special abilities that increases the pool maximum. Some abilities may restore points to this pool during the day. But the defender of the faith may not have more points of Mettle than the pool’s maximum.

The defender of the faith may expend Mettle to gain one of the following benefits.

As an immediate action they may gain a bonus equal to their Charisma modifier on the next saving throw. The bonus must be used before the beginning of their next turn.
As part of making a Strength or Dexterity check to gain a bonus equal to their Charisma bonus on that check. The defender of the faith may restore a point of Mettle to your pool in the following ways.
If the defender of the faith uses the aid another action to assist an ally’s skill check and the ally would have failed the check without the vanguard’s action • If the defender of the faith uses the aid another action to improve an ally’s AC and the ally would have been hit without the their action If an ability which expends Mettle allows for the use of an attack of opportunity, the attack of opportunity allowed by that ability may be taken even while using the total defense action.

Divine Code: must adhere to the tenants of their faith and keep their normal religious holidays and times of prayer. If the defender of the faith does not maintain their faith or adhere to their deity’s tenets, they lose a point of Mettle and their maximum Mettle Pool is reduced by one until 24 hours have passed for each time they have broken this code. These effects are cumulative. Defenders of the faith who violate their this code also lose access to any supernatural abilities granted as part of this archetype.

Protect the Faithful (Su)

At 1st level, a defender of the faith can call upon the powers of their faith to defend themselves and their allies. This ability functions as the paladin ability smite evil except that the target is not restricted by alignment, the usage of this ability costs 1 Mettle and the defender of the faith gains no bonuses to attack or damage. Instead, any attacks made by the target against allies within 10 feet of the defender of the faith deal half damage. Attacks against them deal full damage but the defender of the faith gains a deflection bonus to their AC equal to their Charisma bonus (if any) against attacks by the target.

This bonus increases by +1 for every four class levels to a maximum of +5 at 20th level. The radius of the effect increases to 20 feet at 12th level.

This ability replaces smite evil.

Hands of the Faithful (Su)

At 2nd level, a defender of the faith uses Mettle for their lay on hands or touch of corruption abilities. This ability modifies lay on hands.

Deific Shield (Su)

At 4th level, a defender of the faith channels the power of their faith into their shield. All allies adjacent to the them gain a shield bonus equal to the defender of the faith’s own shield bonus, including all ability and enhancement bonuses. This bonus will not stack with the ally’s own shield bonus. To create this effect, the defender of the faith spends one point of Mettle and lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + the templar’s Charisma bonus (if any).

At 7th level, the radius of protection extends to 10 feet.

At 12th level, the radius extends further to 20 feet.

This ability replaces channel positive energy.

The following three abilities replace divine bond.

Behind Me (Ex)

At 5th level, a defender of the faith may elect to place themselves in the path of danger in order to protect an ally. When rolling initiative, the defender of the faith may select a target as a charge.

This selection may not change for the duration of the encounter. Any time that they are within 5 feet of their charge, and the charge is the target of an attack, the defender of the faith may, as an immediate action, enter the square occupied by the charge and receive the attack in their place. The attack automatically hits the defender of the faith. The charge is placed in any empty square adjacent to the defender of the faith of their choice. The defender of the faith may declare the use of this ability after knowing whether their charge will be hit.

If the defender of the faith suffers a critical hit as a result of using behind me they restore a point of Mettle.

Ever Vigilant (Ex)

At 5th level, all squares the defender of the faith threatens with a melee weapon, including just a shield, are considered difficult terrain for enemies. This ability applies even to jumping, flying, and incorporeal foes, as well as swarms, so long as they wield a melee weapon or shield capable of affecting them. The defender of the faith must be aware of the enemy to affect them.

The defender of the faith also provides cover but not total cover to adjacent allies if their square lies between the ally and the origin of the attack or effect that includes the ally as a target.

Active Defense (Ex)

At 6th level, a defender of the faith may spend a point of Mettle as an immediate action to apply any shield bonus they benefit from to their CMD and touch AC for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma modifier. They may activate this ability even while grappled or otherwise restrained so long as they are still benefiting from a shield bonus.

Starting at 11th level, the defender of the faith may apply this bonus to themselves and one adjacent ally.

Additionally, this ability now adds their shield bonus to Reflex saves during duration.

Starting at 16th level, the defender of the faith’s shield bonus always applies to their own CMD, touch AC and Reflex saving throws. They may now expend a use of Mettle to apply this bonus to up to two adjacent allies.

If the defender of the faith has levels in another class that provides this ability, their effective class levels stack.

Brace (Ex)

At 11th level, if a defender of the faith succeeds on a Reflex save against a spell or effect while wielding a shield they may expend a point of Mettle as an immediate action to prevent that effect from affecting all squares adjacent to them as well as negating the effect fully for themselves.

This ability replaces aura of justice for the paladin.
